CATALOGUE.allowed_information: frozen baseline library, literal evaluator, selected stratum and hypotheses
CATALOGUE.search_rule: Evaluate the applicable frozen catalogue entries in canonical digest order, then the applicable fixed small-order enumeration prefix; do not construct from wall analysis.

GENERIC.allowed_information: literal evaluator, selected stratum, hypotheses, fixed generic operation grammar and deterministic arm seed
GENERIC.search_rule: Run the frozen stratum grammar with its canonical size schedule and seeded proposal order; no equality residual, theorem subtraction, controlling-term sign, or selected wall transformation is an input.

WALL_NAVIGATION.allowed_information: literal evaluator plus completed shared equality, theorem-baseline, residual, and signed controlling-term analysis
WALL_NAVIGATION.search_rule: Choose exactly one applicable P0 transformation id and one finite grid, freeze both with signed effect forecast, then run only that contract.

protocol_invalid_conditions: an arm receives another arm's output before all three terminate
catalogue or generic receives target wall analysis
a seed, operation grammar, transformation, grid, or evaluator changes after the first arm starts
a second wall transformation or expanded near-miss grid is activated
fewer than all frozen process trees are submitted because a crossing was observed
